name: jouledb
description: Local energy-metered SQL, Copy-on-Write database branching, Amorphic VSA search, and interactive MCP App Studio (ui://jouledb/studio.html) powered by JouleDB.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop and Claude Cowork directly to a local JouleDB instance over stdio MCP, including the built-in interactive JouleDB Studio MCP App (sortable SQL workbench, inline SVG distributions, O(1) Copy-on-Write database branch sandboxes, and hardware/analytical joule telemetry).

data_dir.title: Database Directory
data_dir.description: Local directory where JouleDB persists tables, WAL, .jcol columnar segments, and CoW branches.

tools.name: db.studio
tools.description: Open the interactive JouleDB Studio MCP App (SQL workbench, visual charts, schema explorer, CoW branches, and joule telemetry)

tools.name: db.query
tools.description: Execute SQL against JouleDB and render results in the interactive Studio table & chart view

tools.name: db.branch_create
tools.description: Fork an O(1) Copy-on-Write database branch for safe agentic experimentation

tools.name: db.schema_inspect
tools.description: Inspect all tables, columns, and types
